name: sahajta-ads
description: Preview and launch Meta ads (always paused) from a Google Drive folder, through the Sahajta Ads Launcher.
long_description: Ask Claude to launch a folder of creatives into a Meta ad set with a saved copy template. Claude shows you a preview first (names, files, copy, warnings, time estimate) and asks before launching. Every ad and ad set is created paused; you switch them on yourself in Ads Manager. This extension only talks to the launcher's API with your personal key. It never holds the Meta token.
